build_vision_language_model: build a Step3VL vision-language model with StepVLForConditionalGeneration using Step3VLConfig and optional quantization
create_vision_encoder: create a PerceptionEncoder vision transformer with 2D rotary embeddings, convolutional patch embedding, and downsampling
run_image_feature_extraction: run image feature extraction through the perception encoder and project it to language model dimension
test_rotary_embedding: test 2D rotary positional encoding applied to query and key tensors in the vision attention blocks
load_model_weights: load pretrained weights into the model separating vision tower and language model components with name mapping
